question: Which of the following Articles prohibits traffic in human beings and forced labour?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 23**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 23** of the Indian Constitution explicitly prohibits traffic in human beings and forced labour.
 
• This article is a part of the **Fundamental Rights** enshrined in the Constitution to protect individuals against exploitation.
